thread: Maya: Heads up from design review: the right-hand in-app Help drawer uses the heading "Batching suggestions" but the docs page is titled "Batching & caching" and the anchor is #batching-caching. Clicking "Read more" lands users at the top of the docs (no anchor jump) and screen readers don't get context. Ravi: That's probably because the help panel links were shallow and only include /docs/latest/batching. We need full-hash links. Also we should pick a single label across UI + docs. Propose using the longer docs title: "Batching & caching" in help copy, but short table/header labels can be "Batching". Jules: +1 to canonicalizing on the docs phrase. Small UX twist: the drawer UI is tight; long copy like "Batching & caching" looks cramped. Maybe use a short label with a tooltip that shows the full phrase. Felix: Accessibility problem: when we open the docs anchor in a new tab, focus remains in the console. Keyboard users lose the context switch. Recommended behavior: the link should include aria-label that the link opens in a new tab and screen-reader friendly context, and we should set focus to the main content on the docs page after the anchor jump. Nia: Implementation note: our SPA on docs side intercepts navs and sometimes strips hashes. We need to ensure router preserves the hash and scrolls. On the console side, we should link to the full origin + path + hash (e.g. https://docs.redwood.ai/guide/batching#batching-caching). Maya: Copy change suggestion for the drawer list: show short label + inline link text: "Batching (Batching & caching docs, opens in new tab)" — not ideal but explicit for screen readers. Or use visually-hidden text for the parenthetical. Thoughts? Ravi: Use visually-hidden span for the extra text instead of cluttering the UI. Eg: opens in new tab and for link text use "Read full guidance". Avoid repeating the doc title in the tight drawer. Jules: Design tasks: update help drawer token so subtitle/truncation handles a short label and exposes tooltip. Also add an optional prop to Link component to provide externalLinkAccessibilityLabel. Felix: Quick dev checklist: 1) Console: update help drawer links to absolute URL with hash. 2) Console: add rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank" and aria-label from token. 3) Docs: ensure router reads hash on load and calls document.getElementById(hashWithoutHash).focus(); after setting tabindex=-1. 4) Add e2e keyboard test: open drawer, tab to link, activate, assert new tab opened and on docs page main content has focus. Nia: FYI I'll add a small fix to the docs router this sprint to preserve hashes (PR ready). Also will add a tiny focus util we can reuse. Maya: Also noticed we have inconsistent internal terminology: console UI calls it "Batching suggestions" while some docs call out "Batching strategies". Can we choose "Batching & caching" as canonical and add alias anchors for legacy phrases? Ravi: Yes, add H2s with ids: #batching-suggestions and #batching-strategies that jump to the canonical #batching-caching with a short note "This page previously used the term 'batching suggestions' / 'batching strategies' which now map to Batching & caching." That will avoid breaking older links. Jules: Accessibility follow-up: when we programmatically focus the docs main content we need to ensure focus isn't obscured by sticky headers; using element.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) + focus({preventScroll:true}) helps. Add a tiny delay if router transitions animate. Felix: Sample snippet for docs team to use: ``` // on route mount const el = document.getElementById('batching-caching') || document.getElementById(location.hash?.slice(1)); if (el) { el.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); el.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); el.focus({preventScroll:true}); } ``` Nia: I'll make the focus util more robust and include a fallback to main content id 'main'. Maya: OK owners? We need design tokens, console link changes, docs router + anchors, and an a11y review. Ravi: I'll take console link updates + e2e test (ETA 4 days). Jules: I'll update Figma and the Link component (ETA 3 days). Nia: Docs fixes + alias anchors + focus util (ETA 2 days). Felix: I'll do the accessibility review & test plan. docs-bot: Created task #4976: "Normalize 'Batching & caching' across console + docs; add alias anchors and focus behavior for in-app help links" assigned to Nia, Ravi, Jules. Maya: Thanks all. After PRs land let's do a quick pass with VoiceOver and NVDA. Happy to pair. :heart:
